arguments.message:
Hi there! The invite is being blocked because your workspace has reached the seat limit for your current plan. You can see the limit and how many seats are in use under **Settings → Billing → Plan**. To add another user you’ll need to either purchase extra seats (if your plan supports buying additional seats) or upgrade to a plan with a higher seat allowance. Once you increase the limit, the change takes effect immediately and you can resend the invite.

If you need help figuring out which option applies to your plan, just let me know!
